Name: Dino Chickens - A Dinosaur Replacement
Author: Exonika
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fbx89H80/Banner2-0.png[/img]
This mod replaces the vanilla Dinosaur textures and transforms them into Chickens either Green to match the Dinosaur theme or Custom!
​​
​
​
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/jqww5JgN/features.png[/img]

[b]Content Patcher
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]is recommended for configuration. [spoiler]
[b]Vanilla Style, Green Chicken          :   [/b]    Vanilla Green
[b]Vanilla Style, Custom Chicken﻿       :   [/b]    Vanilla Custom
[b]Vanilla Style, Pink Chicken      ﻿       :[/b]       Vanilla Pink
[b]Vanilla Style, Purple Chicken﻿         : [/b]      Vanilla Purple

[b]Facelift Style, Green Chicken[/b]   [b]      :  [/b]     Facelift Green
[b]Facelift Style, Custom Chicken[/b] [b]     :   [/b]    Facelift Custom
[b]Facelift Style, Pink Chicken[/b]          [b]  :    [/b]   Facelift Pink
[b]Facelift Style, Purple Chicken[/b]      [b]  : [/b]      Facelift Purple[/spoiler]

[b]Alternative Textures
[/b]Use the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Scissors-Tool]Scissors Tool[/url] to customise. [spoiler]

[size=3]Content Patcher version.[/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b]
See the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]player's guide to modding[/url]﻿ (or to skip [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]install steps[/url]﻿).

[*][b]Install [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Unzip Content Patcher and move the unzipped file to [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].﻿

[*][b]Download the mod's .rar/.zip document[/b]

[*][b]Unzip the compressed file[/b]

[*][b]Move the unzipped file to your Mods folder[/b]
Your Mods folder should be located in [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

[b]Simplified Changelog.[/b]

      v1.0.0: Initial Release.

      v1.0.1: 1.6.9+ Compability and New Textures.
‍
‍


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7hny6Vpw/compatibility.png[/img]

Multiplayer Compatible: [b]Yes, see under spoiler. [/b]
[spoiler]
[b]Content Patcher version.
[/b]If a farmhand wants their Dino Chickens to match the host's then the farmhand should set their configurations the same.

[b]Alternative Textures version.
[/b]If a farmhand wants their Dino Chickens to match the host's then the farmhand should use the scissors to change them to be the same.
﻿[/spoiler]﻿

Other Mod Compatible: The mod should work completely fine if you don't have another mod replacing the Dinosaur's texture, all other mods beyond that should have no issues in regards to compatibility.
﻿‍

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/d3vzzCDX/other-mods.png[/img]
